title: Sum formula for agreeing coordinates
statement:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$. The number of coordinates $i$ for which $x_i=f(x)$ equals
\[
\sum_{i=1}^n\frac{1+f(x)x_i}{2}.
\]
